narrative: The orchard bench at dusk, the foul sheets still under the stone, the inkhorn in the knot-hole of the plank. The apples are dark over it. No one is in the frame.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked from the house, and did not go back to the bench.

entities.name: the orchard bench
entities.context: In photo: The stone on the foul sheet
